intro.text: You wake up stranded on a beach. Butt naked, mind foggy, debilitating headache. Even worse, you have absolutely no memories. You are suffering from severe case of amnesia. But you know at least two things: your name, and that you have to do something.

choices.text: You look around, trying to determine where you landed.
You blame the Gods for what happened to you.
You try to remember how you end up here.

looking_around.text: You take in all the decor around you. You haven't the faintest idea where you are. It's a just a beach, with hot sand, salty water and absolutely no one near. Staying still won't help your case. You need to act.

choices.text: Scream for help. Maybe someone will hear you.
Get moving and look for help.

blaming_gods.text: Back against the wall, you're reduced to blaming the Holy Three for you inconvenience. You scream insults at the sky, like a psychotic old man. After a couple of insults, you calm yourself and focus. You need to act now.

choices.text: Scream for help. Maybe someone will hear you.
Get moving and look for help.

trying_to_remember.text: You fire up what's left of your brain and dig deep into your memories. You find nothing but a blank, darken page. Your amnesia is absolute. Going at this alone is vain. You need help.

choices.text: Scream for help. Maybe someone will hear you.
Get moving and look for help.

scream_for_help.text: You scream your lungs out. But no one answers. You are alone.

choices.text: Get moving and look for help.

get_moving.text: You start walking. Where to ? You don't know. You leave the shore and reach the edge of an unwelcoming forest. But before you can step one foot in, a group of strange-looking individuals appear out of nowhere and surround you. They are all armed. Their leader looks you up and down and starts laughing at your naked, broken body.

choices.text: You ask for help. You are desperate after all.
You say nothing and tense up your body. Ready yourself for the worst. It might go down sooner than later.
You ask if they need your help. Better not to appear too needy.

ask_for_help.text: You start begging for help, telling them about your situation. But instead of feeling pity for you, they start laughing uncontrollably. You realize they are not samaritans, they are scavengers, bandits. The leader give it to you straight : he's going to sell you a slave to Li'ark.

choices.text: Ready yourself for a fight. You rather die than live as as slave.
Close your eye and brace yourself. You will try something but die in the attempt.

tense_up.text: You puff your chest, display a serious and dramatic look on your face. Anything to show these bandits you're not going down without a fight. But instead of taking you seriously, they laugh. You realize there are no easy way out of this : blood will have to be shed. The leader give it to you straight : he's going to sell you a slave to Li'ark.

choices.text: Ready yourself for a fight. You rather die than live as as slave.
Close your eye and brace yourself. You will try something but die in the attempt.

ask_if_need_help.text: You try to act nonchalant, asking if they need a direction or the time. They start laughing uncontrollably. You realize they are not ordinary folks, they are bandits. They leader steps forward and give it to you straight : he intends to sell you as a slave to Li'ark.

choices.text: Ready yourself for a fight. You rather die than live as as slave.
Close your eye and brace yourself. You will try something but die in the attempt.

ready_for_fight.text: You get into a fighting chance. But five against one, your odds are not in your favour. The bandits lunge at you, all at once. You're done for. Unless..
